statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir_name=$(basename "$current_dir"); git_branch=""; if [ -d "$current_dir/.git" ]; then git_branch=$(cd "$current_dir" && git --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$git_branch" ] && git_branch=" ($git_branch)"; fi; remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); context_info=""; if [ -n "$remaining" ]; then remaining_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$remaining"); context_info=" [ctx: ${remaining_int}%]"; fi; version=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.version'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); echo "${dir_name}${git_branch}${context_info} | v${version} | ${model}"
